mapper.select: SELECT product_model, seq_no2026, unit_quantity FROM ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.boom_top_bottom_plan_date IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.boom_top_bottom_plan_date) <> '/' THEN p.boom_top_bottom_plan_date WHEN p.turntable_plan_date IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.turntable_plan_date) <> '/' THEN p.turntable_plan_date WHEN p.finished_product_plan_date IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(p.finished_product_plan_date, 'YYYY/MM/DD') END AS effective_plan_date FROM buyer_vehicle_plan p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.import_date = (SELECT MAX(import_date) FROM buyer_vehicle_plan WHERE deleted = 0) ) WHERE REGEXP_SUBSTR(effective_plan_date, '[0-9]{4}') || '-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(effective_plan_date, '[0-9]+', 1, 2), 2, '0') = #{planMonth}
SELECT NVL(TO_CHAR(MAX(import_date), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'EMPTY') FROM buyer_vehicle_config WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT vehicle_model, seq_no_2026, material_desc AS host_code, MAX(material_no) AS config_material_no, SUM(NVL(required_quantity, 0)) AS unit_required_quantity FROM buyer_vehicle_config WHERE deleted = 0 AND import_date = (SELECT MAX(import_date) FROM buyer_vehicle_config WHERE deleted = 0) GROUP BY vehicle_model, seq_no_2026, material_desc
SELECT host_code, MAX(teli_code) AS material_no, MAX(name) AS material_name FROM buyer_code_config WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY host_code
SELECT NVL(TO_CHAR(MAX(update_time), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6'), 'EMPTY') FROM buyer_code_config WHERE deleted = 0
